description: Dept. of Fiscal Policy - Amend the Rules on Foolproof  sticker and sticker Management system, published in Gaz. Ex. No. 2147/75
reasoning: This gazette content primarily involves the amendment of excise rules and regulations under the Excise Ordinance. It contains a legal notification (Excise Notification No. 01/2020) that modifies previous gazette notifications regarding sticker requirements for excisable articles. The content focuses on regulatory changes and compliance requirements rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or any of the other specialized categories. This fits the definition of Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) which cover "regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements" and "statutory instruments and subsidiary legislation."
